title: Convolution on the Boolean cube
statement: For functions $f,g:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{R}$, define their convolution at $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$ to be $2^{-n}\sum_{y\in\mathbb{F}_2^n} f(y)g(x-y)$, where subtraction is in $\mathbb{F}_2^n$.
